_comment: Each page loads `lib-abc` and two of `lib-ab`, `lib-ac` and `lib-bc`. Merging `lib-ac` (21 bytes) into `lib-abc` saves pages a and c a request for 21 bytes added to page b, 10.5 bytes per saved request, and merging `lib-bc` into the result then costs the same. Merging `lib-ab` (91 bytes) would add 91 bytes to page c for two saved requests, 45.5 per request, over the budget of 25, so pages a and b load two `lib` chunks and page c one.
